title: Environment Spec V1 — requested environment specification

variant.description: Binary variant, e.g. "cu121", "cu124". Empty for cpu. identity: true

dependency_files.description: Dependency declarations, sorted by repo-relative path. identity: true

sha256.description: Content hash of the file bytes (UTF-8, as-is)

revision.description: Git revision when the dependency source is revision-pinned; joins identity only then

channels.description: Conda channels affecting binary variants, sorted. identity: true

pip_index_profile.description: Normalized mirror profile name (e.g. "aliyun", "pypi"); transient hostnames forbidden. OPERATIONAL metadata (where to download), NOT part of identity — the resolved fingerprint + audit is the correctness backstop. Amended 2026-08-16 after the cross-module upgrade acceptance.

framework_constraints.description: Explicit framework/CUDA constraints from user or upstream task, sorted, e.g. "torch==2.6.*". identity: true

notes.description: Free-form human note. NOT part of identity.
